_note: Paper C Stage 1 cross-architecture grid. One cell = (variant_tag, base_model, subset, seed). Change variant_tags to add or drop a CADF variant; the queue and the checker both read this file.

variant_tag_meaning.k0a: CADF v1.2, absolute K0=15 cycles from the first valid (mask==1) cycle
variant_tag_meaning.eng: CADF v1.2, engineering mode only (no window baseline)

delta_sign: delta_val_rmse = baseline_val_engine_mean_rmse - cadf_val_engine_mean_rmse; positive means CADF is better (lower RMSE)
